items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: And here Bob Britano and all these guys said fine. But he was one of the famous guys from Cortland.

ctx.x: Arnold Gabriel. It was funny, like Toscanini’s son, his father was Frank Crisara. And they had the Old Timer’s Band here in Cortland. And all those musicians, they still have it but it’s not the Old Timers, I mean they’re all gone. They were old timers when I was — 50 years ago they were old timers. They still call it the Old Timers Band. I guess guys like me are in it, but I don’t play in it. So he comes home from playing with Toscanini and they’re having a rehearsal. And Frank Crisara, a handlebar moustache guy…
You know you mentioned Buddy Holly, and that era of rock & roll. When I listen to that music, in fact I play a lot of it now, a lot of it’s basically swing music.
